## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated. Component changes need rendering, keyboard and axe coverage.
- [ ] Docs page updated if the behavior, props, CSS variables or class names changed
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) if this changes what gets published
